Definition: to gulp; figuratively, to be rash
BiblicalUsage: The word means to gulp or swallow down, and Job uses it for his own words, saying they are swallowed up by grief heavier than the sand of the sea. Obadiah turns it against the nations, who shall drink and swallow down until they are as though they had not been.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that what men swallow in pride, God will make them swallow in judgment, while the sufferer who speaks honestly is heard.
